name: Tachibana Shiori
source: [url=/c14023]Yuusuke's[/url] homeroom teacher and childhood friend who also takes care of him because he lives alone. She used to be like like an older sister to Yuusuke when he was younger, and she still calls him the nickname "Yuu-chan". She is a huge masochist who inflicts pain on herself day and night.
